name: REVIVE
question: Does on-demand avanafil improve erectile function over placebo in men with erectile dysfunction?

design.population: 646 adult men with mild to severe erectile dysfunction were randomized.
design.description: Multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized trial; four-week untreated run-in required at least four intercourse attempts, at least 50% failure to maintain erection and IIEF-EF 5–25. Efficacy ITT n=622 required at least one dose and posttreatment efficacy measure; IIEF missing data used last observation carried forward, while SEP2 and SEP3 were not imputed.
design.locator: Full text, Methods, pp 1123–1125; Results, p 1125; Table 1

verdictNote: All three doses improved the coprimary measures over placebo at 12 weeks.
takeaway: In REVIVE, on-demand avanafil 50, 100 or 200 mg improved successful penetration, successful intercourse and IIEF erectile-function scores over placebo after 12 weeks in men with erectile dysfunction.

reports.label: Initial randomized report
reports.citation: Goldstein I, McCullough AR, Jones LA, et al. "A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Evaluation of the Safety and Efficacy of Avanafil in Subjects with Erectile Dysfunction." *J Sex Med.* 2012;9(4):1122-1133. doi:10.1111/j.1743-6109.2011.02629.x

results.measure: Mean change in percentage of attempts with successful vaginal penetration at 12 weeks

effect.p: <0.001 for each avanafil dose versus placebo

results.note: End-of-treatment SEP2 success was nearly 80% for the 100- and 200-mg groups; exact arm means are plotted in Figure 2A.
results.locator: Full text, Results, pp 1125–1127, Figure 2A; Discussion, p 1128

results.measure: Mean change in percentage of attempts with successful intercourse at 12 weeks
results.note: Mean changes from run-in; ITT denominators are from Table 1, while exact endpoint-specific denominators are not stated.
results.locator: Full text, Results, pp 1125–1127, Figure 2B; Table 1

results.measure: Change in International Index of Erectile Function erectile-function domain at 12 weeks
results.note: ITT analysis used last observation carried forward; exact arm means are plotted in Figure 2C.
results.locator: Full text, Statistical Methods, p 1125; Results and Figure 2C, p 1127

results.measure: Successful intercourse among attempts within 15 minutes after dosing
results.note: Post-primary timing analysis; 300 attempts in this interval across all arms.
results.locator: Full text, Main Outcome Measures, p 1125; Results, p 1128, Figure 5

results.measure: Successful intercourse among attempts more than 6 hours after dosing
results.note: Post-primary timing analysis; 80 attempts in this interval across all arms.
results.locator: Full text, Main Outcome Measures, p 1125; Results, p 1128, Figure 5

harms.label: Commonly reported adverse events
harms.note: Treatment-emergent events in the safety population.

harms.label: Drug-related serious adverse events
harms.locator: Full text, Safety, p 1128; Table 3, p 1130
harms.note: No serious adverse event was judged related to study drug; one death from a gunshot wound occurred in the 100-mg arm.

delivery.label: On-demand dosing
delivery.value: Study drug approximately 30 minutes before sexual activity; up to two doses per 24 hours separated by at least 12 hours; no food or alcohol restriction.

reports.label: 52-week open-label extension
reports.citation: Belkoff LH, McCullough A, Goldstein I, et al. "An Open-Label, Long-Term Evaluation of the Safety, Efficacy and Tolerability of Avanafil in Male Patients with Mild to Severe Erectile Dysfunction." *Int J Clin Pract.* 2013;67(4):333-341. doi:10.1111/ijcp.12065
reports.followUp: 52-week open-label extension of REVIVE and a separate diabetes trial

results.measure: Successful intercourse from qualifying-trial run-in to the extension treatment period
results.note: In the 52-week extension of two trials, SEP3 success rose from 13% to 68% in the 100-mg-only group (171 enrolled) and from 11% to 66% in the 100/200-mg group (536 enrolled); efficacy ITT total was 686.
results.locator: Full text, Summary, p 333; Methods, p 335; Results and Table 1, pp 335–336

results.measure: Mean erectile-function domain score in the extension, baseline to follow-up
results.note: Mean IIEF-EF rose from 13.6 to 22.2 in the 100-mg-only group (171 enrolled) and from 11.9 to 22.7 in the 100/200-mg group (536 enrolled); efficacy ITT total was 686.
results.locator: Full text, Summary, p 333; Results and Table 1, pp 335–336

results.measure: Successful vaginal penetration in the extension, parent-trial run-in to treatment period
results.note: SEP2 success rose from 44.1% to 83.3% in the 100-mg-only group (171 enrolled) and from 43.0% to 79.4% in the 100/200-mg group (536 enrolled); efficacy ITT total was 686.
results.locator: Full text, Summary, p 333; Results and Table 1, pp 335–336

results.measure: Response to 200 mg among first-30-day nonresponders to 100 mg who requested escalation
results.note: 112/172 (65.1%) first-30-day nonresponders to 100 mg responded after escalation to 200 mg; response was a positive SEP3 change from parent-trial baseline.

results.measure: Patients with at least one successful intercourse attempt at selected postdose intervals
results.note: 169/203 (83%) patients attempting intercourse within 15 minutes and 48/65 (74%) attempting more than 6 hours after dosing succeeded.
results.locator: Full text, Results and Figure 3, pp 336–337

harms.label: Discontinuation because of adverse events
harms.locator: Full text, Safety outcomes and Table 2, p 339
harms.note: 20/711 (2.8%) of the safety population discontinued because of adverse events.

harms.label: Any treatment-emergent adverse event
harms.value: 275/711 (38.7%) in the safety population; 79/711 (11.1%) were considered drug-related.
harms.locator: Full text, Safety outcomes and Table 2, p 339

harms.label: Serious adverse event
harms.value: 11/711 (1.5%) in the safety population; none considered drug-related; no deaths.
harms.locator: Full text, Safety outcomes and Table 2, p 339

delivery.label: Extension enrollment and dose adjustment
delivery.value: 712 enrolled; 686 in efficacy ITT; 711 received drug for safety analysis. All were assigned 100 mg and could request 200 mg for efficacy or 50 mg for tolerability; 536/712 (75.3%) received both 100 and 200 mg, 171/712 (24.0%) received only 100 mg.
delivery.locator: Full text, Methods, pp 334–335; Results and Table 1, pp 335–336

delivery.label: Extension completion and exposure
delivery.value: Enrollment closed early after FDA exposure targets were met; 492/712 (69.1%) completed; mean avanafil exposure was 35.3 weeks and 153/711 (21.5%) were exposed for at least 52 weeks.
delivery.locator: Full text, Results, pp 335–336; Safety outcomes, p 339
